title: Can Tho Expressway
source_topic: ICPC / The 2020 Asia Can Tho Regional Contest
statement: For up to ten thousand independent queries, each supplying a strip bounded by two distinct parallel lines with small integer coefficients and a convex polygon of three to six integer vertices in either orientation, the task is to decide whether the strip and the polygon share a region of positive area. Meeting only at a single point or along one whole edge does not count.
